name: Frank Walker
role: Medora man who died of an accidental rifle wound
bio: Frank Walker of Medora advertised two stray ponies he had taken up in December 1884, and their owner was found in Red Water, Montana. On February 25, 1885, he was badly hurt when his leg pushed against a loaded rifle lying on a chair and it fired. Medora raffled his rifle, belt and knife for his benefit in early March, raising far more than they were worth, and his leg was amputated. He died of blood poisoning on April 2, 1885.
